nodes.description: Collapsible section: T1 top 3 min, back-off 2 min, T2 top 2 min, isolation 90 sec, warmup/activation 60-90 sec, bridge 90-120 sec

nodes.description: Colocated *.test.ts(x) required for weight utils, components and contexts

nodes.label: SetTable Behaviour Spec
nodes.description: Columns Set name | Weight | Reps; top set row accented; shows em dash when no weight

nodes.label: SonarCloud Analysis
nodes.description: Consumes coverage/lcov.info; SONAR_TOKEN stored only in CircleCI context 'SonarCloud'

nodes.label: WeekStrip Behaviour Spec
nodes.description: Horizontal pill strip on mobile, vertical list on desktop; rest days 40% opacity and not tappable; default active day is today, falling back to Tuesday on rest days

nodes.label: CircleCI Pipeline
nodes.description: Jobs lint-and-typecheck, test (coverage persisted), sonar-scan, build; quality gate only, does not deploy

nodes.description: Mobile single column with 16px padding; desktop two-column: sticky 320px left panel (header, WeekStrip, session meta, rest periods) + scrollable right panel, max width 1200px, 32px gap

nodes.label: Weekly Training Split (Push/Pull/Legs)
nodes.description: Mon rest, Tue Push-Arms, Wed Push-Chest, Thu rest, Fri Pull-Arms, Sat Pull-Back, Sun Legs

nodes.label: Vita Ray Project Spec (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.description: Personal workout plan app for Operation Vita Ray; static React SPA, no backend/auth/database, deployed on Vercel

nodes.label: Rogers Priority (upper chest + lateral delts)
nodes.description: Physique target referenced in exercise notes prioritising upper chest and lateral delts

nodes.label: Tier Percentages (T1/T2/T3 set schemes)
nodes.description: T1 primary compound 5 sets (50/70/100/75/75%), T2 secondary compound 4 sets (55/100/70/70%), T3 isolation 3 sets (75% activation of working weight, 100/100%)

nodes.label: Git Hooks (Husky + lint-staged)
nodes.description: pre-commit runs lint-staged; pre-push runs typecheck && test

nodes.label: ESLint Flat Config (ESLint 9)
nodes.rationale: eslint-config-prettier must be last so ESLint and Prettier never conflict

nodes.label: Military Dossier Aesthetic (Mobile-first)
nodes.rationale: Clean, structured, no decorative fluff

nodes.label: @/ Path Alias
nodes.rationale: Use @/ for all imports, never relative ../../ paths

nodes.label: Program Data (program.ts DAYS) - Single Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: program data (program.ts days) - single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Sets are NOT stored in program.ts; they are generated at render time from tier percentages based on each exercise's tier

nodes.label: Shared Types (DayType, Tier, Unit, Exercise, TrainingDay, SetRow)
nodes.norm_label: shared types (daytype, tier, unit, exercise, trainingday, setrow)

nodes.label: Stack: React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Sass + Tailwind v3
nodes.norm_label: stack: react 19 + vite + typescript + sass + tailwind v3

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment (GitHub auto-deploy on main)
nodes.rationale: CircleCI does not block Vercel deploys; enforcement requires main branch protection requiring CircleCI checks

nodes.label: Project Badges (Vercel, CircleCI, SonarCloud Quality Gate, Coverage)
nodes.norm_label: project badges (vercel, circleci, sonarcloud quality gate, coverage)

nodes.label: Left-side Asymmetry Correction
nodes.rationale: SA Lat Pulldown (Left) and SA Cable Row (Left) are left-only to correct a strength/size asymmetry; marked non-negotiable

nodes.label: Node LTS Pinning (.nvmrc lts/*, engines >=20)
nodes.rationale: Local dev, CI (cimg/node:lts) and Vercel resolve the same LTS release; engines field fails fast on wrong Node major

nodes.label: nodeLinker: node-modules
nodes.rationale: Required for Vite and Tailwind compatibility (no PnP)

nodes.label: Secrets Only in CircleCI Context
nodes.rationale: Contexts are scoped, auditable and reusable; never commit SONAR_TOKEN or set as plain env var

nodes.label: Static SPA (No Backend, No Auth, No DB)
nodes.norm_label: static spa (no backend, no auth, no db)
nodes.rationale: Pure UI app; single page, no routing beyond day selector

nodes.label: Vercel SPA Rewrite (vercel.json)
nodes.rationale: Serve index.html for all paths, required for client-side SPA

nodes.label: Yarn 4 Vendored Binary (yarnPath)
nodes.rationale: Vercel does not officially support Yarn 4 via corepack; committing the binary and setting yarnPath lets Vercel and CI bypass corepack entirely

nodes.label: Typography: Bebas Neue + Inter
nodes.description: Bebas Neue for session titles/day names, Inter for all else, body 14px / line-height 1.6

nodes.label: ThemeContext Spec
nodes.description: Outermost provider; writes localStorage and data-theme on document.documentElement

nodes.label: index.html Entry Document
nodes.description: Root HTML with data-theme="system", #root mount, loads /src/main.tsx as module

nodes.label: Theme System (system / light / dark)
nodes.description: Stored in localStorage 'vita-ray-theme', applied as data-theme on <html>, toggle cycles system -> light -> dark, default system

nodes.label: TierBadge Behaviour Spec
nodes.description: T1 blue, T2 green, T3 amber tint pills

nodes.label: useTheme Hook Spec
nodes.description: Wraps ThemeContext; throws outside ThemeProvider

nodes.label: Per-theme CSS Custom Properties (_variables.scss)
nodes.rationale: All colors via CSS variables; never hardcode hex in JSX or SCSS component files. system defaults to dark and is overridden by prefers-color-scheme: light media query

nodes.label: index.html Spec
nodes.rationale: data-theme="system" set before React hydrates; ThemeContext then updates immediately to prevent a flash of wrong theme

nodes.label: Contexts Consumed Only via Named Hooks
nodes.norm_label: contexts consumed only via named hooks
nodes.rationale: Never call useContext directly in components; use useTheme/useUnit

nodes.label: No scss additionalData Injection
nodes.rationale: _variables.scss defines CSS custom properties, not Sass variables, so import once in main.scss instead of global injection

nodes.label: Vita Ray Favicon (lightning bolt app icon)
nodes.norm_label: vita ray favicon (lightning bolt app icon)
nodes.rationale: 32x32 SVG app icon: a blue lightning bolt on a near-black rounded square. Minimal, flat, no decoration, in line with the military-dossier look. Its colors match the dark-theme palette (#0A0A0A page background, #85B7EB T1/pull accent blue).

nodes.label: Dark Rounded Square Background (#0A0A0A)
nodes.rationale: A 32x32 rect with rx=5 rounded corners, filled with the dark-theme page background color.

nodes.label: Lightning Bolt Glyph (#85B7EB)
nodes.rationale: A polygon lightning bolt standing for energy or vitality ('Vita Ray'). Filled with the dark-theme blue accent used for T1 tier and pull text.

nodes.label: ExerciseCard Behaviour Spec
nodes.description: Collapsed by default; expands to show cue note, top set input (step 5 lbs/2.5 kg) and set table; validates non-numeric/negative input with error messages; chevron rotates 180deg

nodes.label: useUnit Hook Spec
nodes.description: Wraps UnitContext; throws outside UnitProvider

nodes.label: Unit Conversion Rules (lbs<->kg)
nodes.description: lbs->kg x0.453592 round 2.5kg; kg->lbs x2.20462 round 5lbs; top set input converts on unit switch; default lbs; persisted in localStorage 'vita-ray-unit'

nodes.label: UnitToggle Behaviour Spec
nodes.description: lbs/kg pill toggle in header next to ThemeToggle; converts entered top set weights on toggle

nodes.label: Weight Utility (src/utils/weight.ts)
nodes.rationale: All weight math lives in one module; no component performs its own weight calculation

nodes.label: README Notes (lbs default, weight.ts, no persistence)
nodes.norm_label: readme notes (lbs default, weight.ts, no persistence)

nodes.label: Ephemeral Workout State (resets on reload)
nodes.rationale: Top set weight lives in useState per exercise and intentionally resets; only display settings (unit, theme) persist

nodes.label: Weight Rounding Rule (5 lbs / 2.5 kg, nonzero floor)
nodes.norm_label: weight rounding rule (5 lbs / 2.5 kg, nonzero floor)
nodes.rationale: Gym plates don't go to zero, so any nonzero weight floors at one increment instead of rounding to 0

nodes.label: calcSetWeight()
nodes.rationale: Returns em dash when top weight is missing or non-positive.

nodes.label: convertWeight()
nodes.rationale: lbs->kg x0.453592, kg->lbs x2.20462, then rounded to target unit increment.

nodes.label: Per-theme CSS Custom Properties (_variables.scss)
nodes.rationale: All colors via custom properties, never hardcoded hex in components. Defines CSS vars not Sass vars, so it is imported once in main.scss rather than injected via additionalData. System theme uses prefers-color-scheme media query.

nodes.label: ExerciseCard component
nodes.rationale: Collapsed by default; expands to cue note, top-set input, and set table. Input step 5 (lbs) / 2.5 (kg); rejects non-numeric/negative values with error messages without updating the table; chevron rotate is the only animation.

nodes.label: Program Data (src/data/program.ts DAYS)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for workout data; stores only id, tier, name, note per exercise. Sets are generated at render time from tier percentages, not stored. Weekly split: Mon/Thu rest, Tue Push-Arms, Wed Push-Chest, Fri Pull-Arms, Sat Pull-Back, Sun Legs.

nodes.label: Responsive Layout (mobile single column / lg: two column)
nodes.norm_label: responsive layout (mobile single column / lg: two column)
nodes.rationale: Switch at Tailwind lg: (1024px). Desktop: sticky 320px left panel with header, WeekStrip, session meta, rest periods; scrollable right panel with exercise cards; max width 1200px, 32px gap.

nodes.label: roundWeight()
nodes.rationale: Rounds to nearest 5 lbs or 2.5 kg; nonzero weight floors at one increment instead of 0 because gym plates don't go to zero.

nodes.label: SetTable component
nodes.rationale: Receives tier and top weight as props and generates rows; columns Set name | Weight | Reps; shows em dash when no weight.

nodes.label: Shared Types (src/data/types.ts: DayType, Tier, Unit, Exercise, TrainingDay, SetRow)
nodes.norm_label: shared types (src/data/types.ts: daytype, tier, unit, exercise, trainingday, setrow)

nodes.label: Theme System (dark / light / system)
nodes.rationale: Stored in localStorage and applied as data-theme on <html>; default system; toggle cycles system -> light -> dark. index.html sets data-theme=system before hydration to prevent flash of wrong theme.

nodes.label: ThemeContext / ThemeProvider
nodes.rationale: Exposes theme and setTheme; reads/writes localStorage key 'vita-ray-theme', default system; updates data-theme on documentElement; outermost provider.

nodes.label: Tier Percentages (T1 / T2 / T3 set schemes)
nodes.norm_label: tier percentages (t1 / t2 / t3 set schemes)
nodes.rationale: T1: 5 sets (50/70/100/75/75%). T2: 4 sets (55/100/70/70%). T3: 3 sets (75% activation of working weight, 100/100%); T3 uses working weight directly rather than a top set.

nodes.label: UnitContext / UnitProvider
nodes.rationale: Exposes unit and setUnit; reads/writes localStorage key 'vita-ray-unit', default lbs.

nodes.label: UnitToggle component
nodes.rationale: Pill toggle lbs/kg in header; converts all entered top set weights to the new unit on toggle.

nodes.label: useTheme hook
nodes.rationale: Convenience wrapper around ThemeContext; throws outside ThemeProvider. Components must never call useContext directly.

nodes.label: useUnit hook
nodes.rationale: Convenience wrapper around UnitContext; throws outside UnitProvider.

nodes.label: WeekStrip component
nodes.rationale: Horizontal pill strip on mobile, vertical list on desktop; rest days 40% opacity and not tappable; defaults to today, or Tuesday if today is a rest day.

nodes.label: Weight Utility (src/utils/weight.ts)
nodes.rationale: All weight math lives here; no component does its own weight calculation.

nodes.label: No Workout Data Persistence
nodes.rationale: Top set weights live in per-exercise useState and reset on reload intentionally.

nodes.label: Unit Conversion Rules (default lbs, persisted)
nodes.rationale: Unit preference persists in localStorage as an exception to the no-persistence rule because it is a display setting, not workout data.

nodes.label: CircleCI Pipeline (lint, test, sonar-scan, build)
nodes.rationale: Quality gate only, does not deploy; no corepack step since yarn-berry orb uses the vendored binary.

nodes.label: ESLint Flat Config (eslint-config-prettier last)
nodes.rationale: eslint-config-prettier must be last so it disables all formatting rules and ESLint never conflicts with Prettier.

nodes.label: Husky + lint-staged Git Hooks
nodes.rationale: pre-commit runs lint-staged; pre-push runs typecheck and tests as a gate.

nodes.label: SonarCloud Analysis
nodes.rationale: SONAR_TOKEN lives in a CircleCI context named SonarCloud, never committed or set as plain project env var, because contexts are scoped, auditable, and reusable.

nodes.label: Stack: React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Sass + Tailwind v3
nodes.norm_label: stack: react 19 + vite + typescript + sass + tailwind v3

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment (SPA rewrite to index.html)
nodes.rationale: Rewrites all paths to index.html for client-side SPA; Vercel auto-deploys from main via GitHub integration independently of CircleCI.

nodes.label: Vite Config (@ alias, vitest test block)
nodes.norm_label: vite config (@ alias, vitest test block)

nodes.label: Vita Ray App (Operation Vita Ray)
nodes.rationale: Static React app with no backend, auth, or database; pure UI deployed on Vercel.

nodes.label: nodeLinker: node-modules
nodes.rationale: Required for Vite and Tailwind compatibility.

nodes.label: Node LTS Pinning (.nvmrc lts/* + engines >=20)
nodes.rationale: Local dev, CI, and Vercel resolve the same LTS release; engines field fails fast on wrong Node major.

nodes.label: Yarn 4 Vendored Binary (yarnPath)
nodes.rationale: Vercel does not officially support Yarn 4 via corepack; committing the binary and setting yarnPath lets Vercel bypass corepack entirely. Never use npm, npx, or corepack anywhere, including CI.
